metadata.title: Unblocking the Team.
metadata.note: Weekly progress report, week of 2026-09-04. Through-line: every blocker hit this week was turned into a reusable asset — the GitHub wall became a video, the Suno learning curve became a series, the signup maze is becoming written docs. Six beats: four purpose-built HaiProgress* scenes (B01-B04), one ClaudeComposerAsk opener (B00), one ClaudeTitleOutro (B05). Target 2:00. HAI channel standard: opener says 'Hi, I'm Rohan, for Humanitarians AI', closer says 'I'm Rohan Vijaykumar, for Humanitarians AI'. NAME PRONUNCIATION: narration_text spells the presenter's name phonetically as 'Row-Haan VeeJayKooMaar' so Kokoro says it correctly; all ON-SCREEN text keeps the correct spelling 'Rohan Vijaykumar'. Never let the phonetic spelling leak into props. No individuals named beyond the presenter; no Pro-access perk framing.

beats.narration_text: Hi, I'm Row-Haan, for Humanitarians AI. This week I didn't ship a research result. I shipped training material. Our marketing team was blocked on one step, and our incoming fellows had nothing to onboard with. Both of those were fixable, so that's where the week went. Here's what got built, and what's still open.

props.command: Give me this week's progress update. What did I unblock, what did I ship, and what is still in flight?
output: the signup path, getting written down

beats.narration_text: Start with the blocker. Our marketing team is creative — making things was never their problem. What they couldn't do was get finished work onto GitHub. They're all non-technical, and that single step was stopping completed videos from ever being submitted. I'd already solved it for myself, so at the start of the week I ran a workshop, then packaged the whole setup as a video. Now nobody has to sit in a live session to learn it.

props.title: The Blocker Worth Fixing
props.sparkLine: The work was never the problem. The last step was.

beats.narration_text: Most of the week went into the Suno tutorial series. Three parts, all finished, all in four K — about ten and a half minutes of training material for new members of the team. Part one gets you to your first song. Part two is prompt craft: how to describe a sound and actually get that sound. Part three covers refining and exporting. And every screen of Suno's interface is rebuilt in code rather than screen-recorded, so the series doesn't rot the next time they ship a redesign.

props.title: The Suno Training Series

parts.name: Crafting Your Prompt
parts.skill: describe a sound, get that sound

props.footnote: Every Suno screen is rebuilt in code, not screen-recorded — so the series does not rot the next time the interface changes.

beats.narration_text: The other piece is written, not filmed. A new fellow needs four accounts before they can make anything — Discord, Suno, Midjourney, and Adobe Creative Cloud. Right now that path is tribal knowledge: you find out by asking someone who already did it. I'm writing it down as proper documentation, so how do I get access stops being a question anyone has to ask twice.

props.title: Four Accounts Before You Make Anything

beats.narration_text: Next up is the Midjourney series. Same approach — interface rebuilt in code, written for people with no background in it. That should be done by the end of next week, and the signup guide lands alongside it.

props.title: Shipped, and What Is Next

next.label: Midjourney series
next.sub: same approach, interface rebuilt in code

props.sparkLine: Same approach, pointed at the next tool.

beats.narration_text: A blocked team, unblocked. A training series, shipped. And a signup path finally getting written down. I'm Row-Haan VeeJayKooMaar, for Humanitarians AI.
